halfLife.notes: Apparent half-life is short, but the drug is an IRREVERSIBLE inhibitor of MAO-A and MAO-B — biological effect persists until new MAO enzyme is synthesised (10–14 days). 14-day washout is required before any serotonergic agent. Availability in Malaysia is limited — frequently sourced from compounding pharmacies or imported. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: No clinically significant active metabolite for mood. Hydrazine metabolites contribute to hepatotoxicity risk.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Phenelzine is an irreversible MAOI — once given, the only way to lose enzyme inhibition is to wait for new enzyme synthesis (~14 days). Any cross-taper with a serotonergic drug (SSRI, SNRI, TCA, mirtazapine) risks fatal serotonin syndrome. Hypertensive crisis with tyramine-containing foods (aged cheese, cured meats, fermented foods) — strict dietary counselling mandatory. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: 14-day washout in either direction. This is non-negotiable — irreversible enzyme inhibition cannot be 'rushed'.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: MAOI withdrawal (especially abrupt) can cause agitation, irritability, sleep and movement disorders (myoclonus, choreoathetosis), cognitive impairment, slurred speech. Occasionally hallucinations and paranoid delusions. Taper slowly. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Limited availability in Malaysian formulary. Specialist mental-health pharmacies or import via NPRA's special-access route. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
